نستحوش (form X)
# نَسْتَحْوِشُ (nastaḥwišu) /nas.taħ.wi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
# نَسْتَحْوِشَ (nastaḥwiša) /nas.taħ.wi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
# نَسْتَحْوِشْ (nastaḥwiš) /nas.taħ.wiʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
